entries.meaningZh: 沿海岸或湖岸的
entries.en: The survey mapped the littoral habitats between the cliffs and the open sea.
entries.zh: 这次调查绘制了悬崖与外海之间的沿岸栖息地分布图。

entries.meaningZh: 装液体的小玻璃瓶；小药瓶
entries.en: The scientist placed a sealed phial of clear liquid on the bench.
entries.zh: 科学家把一只装有透明液体的密封小玻璃瓶放在实验台上。

entries.meaningZh: 把冲动或情绪转化为更有建设性的活动
entries.en: She sublimated her frustration into an ambitious series of paintings.
entries.zh: 她把挫折感转化为创作动力，画出了一组雄心勃勃的作品。

entries.meaningZh: 演奏或表演中大胆华丽的精湛技巧
entries.en: The pianist combined dazzling bravura with an unusually delicate touch.
entries.zh: 这位钢琴家把令人眼花缭乱的华丽技巧与格外细腻的触键结合起来。

entries.meaningZh: 能够承受高温的；耐火的
entries.en: Refractory bricks lined the inside of the pottery kiln.
entries.zh: 陶窑内部衬着耐火砖。

entries.meaningZh: 足病医生；治疗足部问题的专业人员
entries.en: The clinic's new podiatrist gave a talk about her work.
entries.zh: 诊所新来的足病医生作了一场介绍自己工作的讲座。

entries.meaningZh: 使心怀怨恨；使愤愤不平
entries.en: Years of broken promises had embittered the former supporters.
entries.zh: 多年来屡屡落空的承诺，让昔日的支持者心怀怨恨。

entries.meaningZh: 邪恶的；恶棍般的
entries.en: The villainous landlord planned to seize the villagers' homes.
entries.zh: 那个邪恶的地主打算夺走村民们的家园。

entries.meaningZh: 分开地；破裂地，文学用语
entries.en: The earthquake tore the old bridge asunder.
entries.zh: 地震把那座旧桥撕裂了。

entries.meaningZh: 文件末尾增补的内容；补遗
entries.en: An addendum to the report corrected the figures for last year.
entries.zh: 报告的一份补遗更正了去年的数字。

entries.meaningZh: 通过夸张模仿产生讽刺或滑稽效果的作品
entries.en: Their sketch was a burlesque of a pompous awards ceremony.
entries.zh: 他们的小品夸张地模仿了一场装腔作势的颁奖典礼，产生滑稽的讽刺效果。

entries.meaningZh: 乡巴佬；美国乡村或山地居民的轻蔑称呼
entries.en: The traveller objected when the reporter called local residents hillbillies.
entries.zh: 记者把当地居民叫作乡巴佬时，那位旅客表示了反对。

entries.meaningZh: 告密；打小报告，非正式用语
entries.en: He promised not to snitch on the children who broke the window.
entries.zh: 他答应不告发那些打破窗户的孩子。

entries.meaningZh: 腹语表演者
entries.en: The ventriloquist made the wooden puppet seem to answer back.
entries.zh: 腹语表演者让那只木偶看起来像是在回嘴。

entries.meaningZh: 神态；仪表；举止，文学用语
entries.en: Her calm mien concealed the anxiety she felt before the interview.
entries.zh: 她平静的神态掩盖了面试前内心的焦虑。

entries.meaningZh: 迅速；敏捷
entries.en: The swiftness of the rescue surprised even the experienced harbour crew.
entries.zh: 救援行动之迅速，连经验丰富的港口工作人员都感到惊讶。

entries.meaningZh: 为回避承诺或隐瞒实情而含糊其辞
entries.en: Her direct question left him little room for equivocation.
entries.zh: 她直截了当的问题几乎不给他含糊其辞的余地。

entries.meaningZh: 新闻报道；对事件的新闻记录
entries.en: The documentary combines eyewitness reportage with photographs from the archive.
entries.zh: 这部纪录片结合了目击报道与档案照片。

entries.meaningZh: 味道浓郁而令人爽口的；有滋味的
entries.en: A zesty lemon dressing brightened the simple bean salad.
entries.zh: 一份清爽浓郁的柠檬调味汁，让简单的豆子沙拉更有滋味。

entries.meaningZh: 渴望的；想要的，正式用语
entries.en: She was desirous of making a good impression on her first day.
entries.zh: 她渴望在第一天给人留下好印象。

entries.meaningZh: 旅途中转时的短暂停留
entries.en: We had a three-hour layover before the connecting flight.
entries.zh: 在转乘下一班飞机之前，我们中途停留了三个小时。

entries.meaningZh: 与当时季节不相称地；反常地
entries.en: It was unseasonably warm for a morning in late November.
entries.zh: 对于十一月下旬的一个早晨来说，天气暖得反常。

entries.meaningZh: 不断批评、追问而促使他人行动的人
entries.en: The persistent journalist became a gadfly to the complacent city council.
entries.zh: 那位坚持追问的记者，成了不断督促自满的市议会的人。

entries.meaningZh: 使高尚；使具有尊严
entries.en: Her quiet generosity ennobled an otherwise ordinary occasion.
entries.zh: 她默默展现的慷慨，使这个原本普通的场合有了高尚的意义。

entries.meaningZh: 赔偿某人的损失；作出损失补偿
entries.en: The agreement required the supplier to indemnify the shop for damaged goods.
entries.zh: 协议要求供货商赔偿商店因货物损坏遭受的损失。

entries.meaningZh: 西班牙式斗牛中的主斗牛士
entries.en: The museum displayed the embroidered jacket of a famous matador.
entries.zh: 博物馆展出了一位著名斗牛士穿过的刺绣夹克。

entries.meaningZh: 教学的；与教学方法有关的
entries.en: The workshop explored the pedagogic value of discussing mistakes openly.
entries.zh: 这次工作坊探讨了公开讨论错误的教学价值。

entries.meaningZh: 骗取钱财；诈骗
entries.en: The fake travel agency bilked customers out of their holiday savings.
entries.zh: 那家假旅行社骗走了顾客为度假攒下的钱。

entries.meaningZh: 只有头衔而无实际权力的；名义上的
entries.en: He remained the titular chairman while his deputy made every important decision.
entries.zh: 他仍是名义上的主席，但所有重要决定都由副手作出。

entries.meaningZh: 掌握巨大经济或政治权力的寡头
entries.en: A small circle of oligarchs controlled the country's most profitable industries.
entries.zh: 少数几个寡头控制着该国利润最高的产业。

entries.meaningZh: 抬高某事物的地位或重要性
entries.en: I will not dignify that absurd accusation with a reply.
entries.zh: 我不会作答，让那项荒谬的指控显得值得重视。

entries.meaningZh: 稀粥；用谷物煮成的稀薄食物
entries.en: The travellers shared a bowl of warm gruel before setting out.
entries.zh: 旅客们出发前分着喝了一碗热稀粥。

entries.meaningZh: 肖像画家；肖像创作者
entries.en: The portraitist asked her sitter to turn towards the window.
entries.zh: 肖像画家请模特转向窗户。

entries.meaningZh: 秘密或不公开的会议
entries.en: Party leaders held a private conclave before announcing their joint proposal.
entries.zh: 各党领导人在宣布联合提案前举行了一次秘密会议。

entries.meaningZh: 伪造文书、钞票或艺术品的人
entries.en: The forger copied the signature but used ink unavailable at the time.
entries.zh: 伪造者模仿了签名，却用了当时尚不存在的墨水。

entries.meaningZh: 与研钵配套、用来捣碎材料的杵
entries.en: She used a pestle and mortar to crush the dried spices.
entries.zh: 她用杵和研钵捣碎了干香料。

entries.meaningZh: 使订婚；许配，较古旧用语
entries.en: In the novel, she is betrothed to a man she has never met.
entries.zh: 在小说中，她被许配给了一个从未见过的男人。

entries.meaningZh: 石匠
entries.en: The stonemason carved a replacement block for the damaged arch.
entries.zh: 石匠雕好了一块替换用的石料，用来修复损坏的拱门。

entries.meaningZh: 工作职位附带的额外待遇或福利
entries.en: Free use of the swimming pool was a welcome perquisite of the job.
entries.zh: 可以免费使用游泳池，是这份工作一项令人高兴的额外福利。

entries.meaningZh: 对某人动机或行为的负面归属；指责
entries.en: She firmly rejected the imputation that she had acted dishonestly.
entries.zh: 她坚决否认了指称她行事不诚实的说法。

entries.meaningZh: 彗星的；与彗星有关的
entries.en: The probe collected data on cometary dust far from Earth.
entries.zh: 探测器在远离地球的地方收集了彗星尘埃的数据。

entries.meaningZh: 为非作歹者；恶棍，有时带诙谐意味
entries.en: The caretaker finally caught the miscreant who kept painting the gate purple.
entries.zh: 管理员终于抓住了那个老把大门涂成紫色的捣乱家伙。

entries.meaningZh: 缝合伤口或组织的缝线
entries.en: The training model showed how a suture held the artificial tissue together.
entries.zh: 训练模型展示了缝线如何把人造组织固定在一起。

entries.meaningZh: 喋喋不休的；话多的
entries.en: Our garrulous neighbour described every detail of his journey.
entries.zh: 我们那位话多的邻居讲述了旅途中的每一个细节。

entries.meaningZh: 供长期疗养或休养的医疗机构；疗养院
entries.en: The former sanatorium has been converted into a mountain hotel.
entries.zh: 从前的疗养院已被改建成一家山间旅馆。

entries.meaningZh: 使惊呆；使难以思考
entries.en: The sudden announcement stupefied everyone waiting outside the office.
entries.zh: 那项突如其来的宣布让等在办公室外的人全都惊呆了。

entries.meaningZh: 仔细打扮；整理自己的仪容
entries.en: He primped in front of the mirror before the graduation photograph.
entries.zh: 拍毕业照前，他在镜子前仔细整理了仪容。

entries.meaningZh: 母猪产仔
entries.en: The sow farrowed in the warm barn during the night.
entries.zh: 那头母猪夜里在温暖的牲口棚里产了仔。

entries.meaningZh: 盛水或酒用的敞口玻璃壶
entries.en: A carafe of water stood beside the bread basket.
entries.zh: 面包篮旁放着一壶水。

entries.meaningZh: 小争吵；小口角
entries.en: They had a brief tiff about the washing-up but soon made peace.
entries.zh: 他们为洗碗的事小吵了一下，但很快就和好了。

entries.meaningZh: 动物患疥癣而毛皮脱落不整的
entries.en: A mangy stray dog waited outside the abandoned farmhouse.
entries.zh: 一只患疥癣、毛皮斑秃的流浪狗等在废弃的农舍外。

entries.meaningZh: 符合母语表达习惯的；地道的
entries.en: The sentence is grammatical but does not sound idiomatic to native speakers.
entries.zh: 这句话语法正确，但母语使用者听起来觉得不够地道。

entries.meaningZh: 高度赞扬；颂扬
entries.en: Former students eulogized the retiring teacher at the farewell dinner.
entries.zh: 昔日的学生在告别晚宴上高度赞扬了这位即将退休的老师。

entries.meaningZh: 自由职业者；为不同客户独立工作的人
entries.en: As a freelancer, she designs websites for several small businesses.
entries.zh: 作为自由职业者，她为几家小企业设计网站。

entries.meaningZh: 多个国家或团体组成的联盟；邦联
entries.en: The coastal towns formed a confederacy to defend their trading routes.
entries.zh: 沿海城镇组成了联盟，保护各自的贸易路线。

entries.meaningZh: 形态或才能多变的；变化多端的
entries.en: The actor's protean talent allowed her to play several contrasting roles.
entries.zh: 这位演员多变的才华使她能够扮演几个截然不同的角色。

entries.meaningZh: 刚从卵中孵出的幼鸟或其他幼体
entries.en: The hatchling struggled out of its shell beneath the nesting bird.
entries.zh: 亲鸟身下，刚孵出的小鸟奋力钻出了蛋壳。

entries.meaningZh: 容易引燃的干燥材料；火绒
entries.en: The guide kept dry tinder in a small waterproof pouch.
entries.zh: 向导把干燥的火绒放在一个小防水袋里。

entries.meaningZh: 正式授予职位或荣誉的仪式；授职仪式
entries.en: Her family attended the investiture where she received the university's highest honour.
entries.zh: 家人出席了授荣仪式，她在仪式上获得了大学的最高荣誉。

entries.meaningZh: 卖弄运动技巧；炫技，主要美式口语
entries.en: The skier hotdogged for the cameras at the end of the run.
entries.zh: 那名滑雪者在滑行末段对着镜头炫起了技。

entries.meaningZh: 形式较自由、情感奔放的乐曲；狂想曲
entries.en: The orchestra opened the concert with a lively rhapsody for piano and strings.
entries.zh: 乐团以一首活泼的钢琴与弦乐狂想曲为音乐会开场。

entries.meaningZh: 使失去覆盖物；使裸露
entries.en: Years of erosion had denuded the hillside of vegetation.
entries.zh: 多年的侵蚀使山坡失去了植被覆盖。

entries.meaningZh: 幽灵；模糊如影的身影
entries.en: A pale wraith seemed to drift through the fog in the story.
entries.zh: 在故事中，一个苍白的幽灵仿佛从雾中飘过。

entries.meaningZh: 爱吹嘘的；自夸的
entries.en: His boastful account of the match irritated the rest of the team.
entries.zh: 他对比赛自吹自擂的讲述惹恼了队里的其他人。

entries.meaningZh: 日常的；平凡而普通的
entries.en: The poet finds beauty in quotidian tasks such as washing cups.
entries.zh: 这位诗人在洗杯子之类平凡的日常事务中发现美。

entries.meaningZh: 坦率的；不隐瞒的
entries.en: She was upfront about the difficulties the project would face.
entries.zh: 她坦率地说明了项目将面临的困难。

entries.meaningZh: 处理事情灵巧熟练的；机敏的
entries.en: His adroit handling of the discussion prevented an awkward confrontation.
entries.zh: 他巧妙地引导了讨论，避免了一场尴尬的冲突。

entries.meaningZh: 有袋类动物
entries.en: The kangaroo display introduced visitors to this familiar Australian marsupial.
entries.zh: 袋鼠展区向参观者介绍了这种熟悉的澳大利亚有袋类动物。

entries.meaningZh: 付给报酬；酬劳
entries.en: The organisation remunerates translators according to the length of each assignment.
entries.zh: 该机构根据每项任务的篇幅向译者支付报酬。

entries.meaningZh: 幼儿蹒跚学步
entries.en: The little girl toddled towards her father with both arms outstretched.
entries.zh: 小女孩伸出双臂，摇摇晃晃地朝父亲走去。

entries.meaningZh: 急促而含糊地说话
entries.en: He gabbled through the instructions so quickly that nobody understood them.
entries.zh: 他把说明说得又快又含糊，谁也没听懂。

entries.meaningZh: 咖啡壶
entries.en: The empty coffeepot stood beside a stack of breakfast plates.
entries.zh: 空咖啡壶放在一摞早餐盘子旁。

entries.meaningZh: 独裁者；独断专行的人
entries.en: The committee resented being managed by an autocrat who ignored every suggestion.
entries.zh: 委员会成员很反感那个无视一切建议、独断专行的管理者。

entries.meaningZh: 使自己讨好于某人；奉承以博取好感
entries.en: He tried to ingratiate himself with the director by praising every proposal.
entries.zh: 他对每个提案都大加赞扬，试图讨好主管。

entries.meaningZh: 换羽；换毛，美式拼写
entries.en: The parrot began to molt, leaving feathers on the floor.
entries.zh: 鹦鹉开始换羽，地板上落下了羽毛。

entries.meaningZh: 笨蛋；蠢人，强烈侮辱性用语
entries.en: She regretted calling her colleague an imbecile during the argument.
entries.zh: 她后悔在争论中把同事骂作蠢人。

entries.meaningZh: 使转世；使以另一生命形态重生
entries.en: In the story, the old musician is reincarnated as a bird.
entries.zh: 在故事中，那位老音乐家转世成了一只鸟。

entries.meaningZh: 用花、旗帜等大量装饰
entries.en: The children bedecked the garden gate with ribbons and paper flowers.
entries.zh: 孩子们用丝带和纸花把花园大门装饰起来。

entries.meaningZh: 地理上的回归线
entries.en: The geography teacher marked each tropic with a red line.
entries.zh: 地理老师用红线标出了每一条回归线。

entries.meaningZh: 议会中终结辩论、进入表决的程序
entries.en: The senators voted for cloture to bring the lengthy debate to an end.
entries.zh: 参议员投票赞成终结辩论程序，以结束漫长的讨论。

entries.meaningZh: 遮盖头顶秃发处的小块假发
entries.en: A gust of wind lifted the actor's toupee during rehearsal.
entries.zh: 排练时，一阵风掀起了演员头顶的假发。

entries.meaningZh: 非常美味的，非正式用语
entries.en: The bakery served scrumptious pastries filled with apples and cinnamon.
entries.zh: 这家面包店供应非常美味的苹果肉桂馅糕点。

entries.meaningZh: 冶金学；研究金属提取和加工的学科
entries.en: Her degree in metallurgy led to work on lightweight metal alloys.
entries.zh: 她取得冶金学学位后，从事轻质金属合金方面的工作。

entries.meaningZh: 让人暂时逃离现实烦恼的
entries.en: After a difficult week, she wanted an entertaining escapist novel.
entries.zh: 辛苦了一周之后，她想读一本有趣、能让人暂忘现实烦恼的小说。

entries.meaningZh: 正式禁止；下令制止
entries.en: The decree interdicted hunting inside the protected forest.
entries.zh: 那项法令禁止在受保护的森林内狩猎。

entries.meaningZh: 转瞬即逝的；容易消散的
entries.en: The photographer tried to capture the evanescent colours of the sunset.
entries.zh: 摄影师试图捕捉落日转瞬即逝的色彩。

entries.meaningZh: 结构自由、富于想象的乐曲；幻想曲
entries.en: The composer wrote a fantasia based on three local folk songs.
entries.zh: 作曲家根据三首当地民歌创作了一首幻想曲。

entries.meaningZh: 模仿他人风格或行为的
entries.en: Her early poems were imitative, but she later developed a distinctive voice.
entries.zh: 她早期的诗带有模仿色彩，但后来形成了独特的风格。

entries.meaningZh: 潜望镜
entries.en: The submarine's periscope rose briefly above the calm water.
entries.zh: 潜艇的潜望镜短暂地露出了平静的水面。

entries.meaningZh: 因反复使用而陈腐的；老套的
entries.en: The ending relied on a hackneyed phrase about dreams coming true.
entries.zh: 结尾依赖了一句关于梦想成真的陈词滥调。

entries.meaningZh: 兼采多种风格或来源的做法；折衷主义
entries.en: The restaurant's eclecticism brought together dishes from several culinary traditions.
entries.zh: 这家餐厅兼收并蓄，汇集了几种烹饪传统的菜肴。

entries.meaningZh: 古罗马军队中的百夫长
entries.en: The centurion ordered his soldiers to hold their position.
entries.zh: 百夫长命令士兵坚守阵地。

entries.meaningZh: 迷恋的；深深喜爱的，美式拼写
entries.en: She became enamored of the village during her first summer there.
entries.zh: 第一个夏天住在那里时，她就深深喜爱上了这个村庄。

entries.meaningZh: 在同一时间发生的
entries.en: The two festivals were coincident, so visitors had to choose between them.
entries.zh: 两个节日活动时间重合，游客们只好二选一。

entries.meaningZh: 芭蕾舞等中的单足旋转动作
entries.en: The dancer ended her solo with a controlled pirouette.
entries.zh: 舞者以一次平稳的单足旋转结束了独舞。

entries.meaningZh: 通过历史文献研究语言的学科；语文学
entries.en: Her training in philology helped her interpret the damaged medieval text.
entries.zh: 语文学训练帮助她解读了那份损坏的中世纪文献。

entries.meaningZh: 火成的；由熔融岩石冷却凝固形成的
entries.en: The geologist compared an igneous rock with a sedimentary sample.
entries.zh: 地质学家把一块火成岩与一份沉积岩样品作了比较。

entries.meaningZh: 旋转；回旋运动
entries.en: The camera followed the graceful gyrations of the dancer's skirt.
entries.zh: 镜头跟随着舞者裙摆优美的旋转。

entries.meaningZh: 排便，正式或生物学用语
entries.en: The zookeeper noted when the rescued animal ate and defecated.
entries.zh: 动物园饲养员记录了那只获救动物进食和排便的时间。

entries.meaningZh: 为平息不满而作出的小让步或小好处
entries.en: The small refund was dismissed as a sop to angry customers.
entries.zh: 那笔小额退款被斥为只是在安抚愤怒的顾客。

entries.meaningZh: 使失去活性或作用
entries.en: The experiment examined ways to inactivate the enzyme.
entries.zh: 实验研究了使这种酶失活的方法。

entries.meaningZh: 使问题变得模糊难懂；故意混淆
entries.en: The report used technical language to obfuscate a straightforward accounting error.
entries.zh: 报告用技术性语言掩饰了一个简单明了的记账错误。

entries.meaningZh: 把材料转化为可燃气体的过程；气化
entries.en: The engineering lecture compared gasification with direct combustion of the same fuel.
entries.zh: 工程学讲座比较了同一种燃料的气化与直接燃烧。

entries.meaningZh: 暗中进行而不诚实的；不光明正大的
entries.en: They condemned the underhanded tactics used to exclude smaller competitors.
entries.zh: 他们谴责了那些用于排挤较小竞争者的不光彩手段。

entries.meaningZh: 女性体态丰满的，尤指胸部丰满
entries.en: The painter depicted a buxom woman carrying a basket of flowers.
entries.zh: 画家描绘了一位提着花篮、体态丰满的女子。

entries.meaningZh: 缺乏深入思考；肤浅
entries.en: The review criticised the superficiality of the film's treatment of grief.
entries.zh: 评论批评了这部电影对悲伤的处理过于肤浅。

entries.meaningZh: 不可侵犯、破坏或违背的
entries.en: The organisation treats the confidentiality of personal records as inviolable.
entries.zh: 这个组织认为个人记录的保密性不可侵犯。

entries.meaningZh: 使交织；交错编在一起
entries.en: She interlaced the coloured ribbons to make a patterned bracelet.
entries.zh: 她把彩色丝带交织起来，做成了一条带花纹的手链。

entries.meaningZh: 信件开头的称呼或问候语
entries.en: The letter began with a formal salutation and ended with warm thanks.
entries.zh: 这封信以正式的称呼开头，以热情的感谢结束。

entries.meaningZh: 使极度消瘦
entries.en: The prolonged drought had emaciated the cattle on the remote farm.
entries.zh: 长期干旱使偏远农场的牛变得极度消瘦。

entries.meaningZh: 挑战传统观念或制度的人
entries.en: As an artistic iconoclast, she questioned conventions that other painters accepted.
entries.zh: 作为挑战艺术传统的人，她质疑其他画家接受的惯例。

entries.meaningZh: 研究衰老及老年生活的学科；老年学
entries.en: Her research in gerontology examines friendships and independence in later life.
entries.zh: 她在老年学领域的研究考察了晚年生活中的友谊与独立性。

entries.meaningZh: 好斗的；喜欢争吵的
entries.en: His pugnacious style turned a routine discussion into a heated argument.
entries.zh: 他好斗的作风把一次例行讨论变成了激烈的争论。

entries.meaningZh: 不肯配合或不能正常运作的，主要美式用语
entries.en: The balky printer stopped again just before the meeting.
entries.zh: 就在开会前，那台不听使唤的打印机又停了。

entries.meaningZh: 重新结合；重组
entries.en: The designer recombined familiar shapes into an unexpectedly elegant pattern.
entries.zh: 设计师重新组合了常见形状，形成了一种出人意料地优雅的图案。

entries.meaningZh: 故意传播的虚假消息；谣言
entries.en: The newspaper withdrew the canard after checking the original interview recording.
entries.zh: 报纸核查了采访原始录音后，撤回了那则虚假消息。

entries.meaningZh: 掩饰真实感受或意图
entries.en: She tried to dissemble her disappointment with a polite smile.
entries.zh: 她试图用礼貌的微笑掩饰失望。

entries.meaningZh: 硅酸盐
entries.en: The geology class identified several silicate minerals in the rock sample.
entries.zh: 地质课上，学生们在岩石样品中识别出了几种硅酸盐矿物。

entries.meaningZh: 介词
entries.en: The teacher asked us to choose the correct preposition for each sentence.
entries.zh: 老师让我们为每个句子选择正确的介词。

entries.meaningZh: 删节文字而保留主要内容
entries.en: The editor abridged the memoir for a shorter paperback edition.
entries.zh: 编辑删节了这部回忆录，以推出篇幅较短的平装版。

entries.meaningZh: 被认为亵渎神圣事物的
entries.en: Some worshippers regarded the proposed alteration to the shrine as sacrilegious.
entries.zh: 一些信众认为拟议中对神殿的改动亵渎了神圣。

entries.meaningZh: 使着迷；使欣喜若狂
entries.en: The singer's clear voice enraptured the audience in the small chapel.
entries.zh: 歌手清澈的嗓音让小教堂里的听众陶醉。

entries.meaningZh: 对困境中人的援助或救济，美式拼写
entries.en: The isolated village received succor from neighbouring communities after the storm.
entries.zh: 暴风雨后，那个与外界隔绝的村庄得到了邻近社区的救助。

entries.meaningZh: 生活中肮脏、丑恶或不体面的一面的
entries.en: The documentary reveals the seamy side of the glamorous entertainment industry.
entries.zh: 这部纪录片揭示了光鲜娱乐业的丑恶一面。

entries.meaningZh: 雄鹅
entries.en: A white gander guarded the goslings near the water.
entries.zh: 一只白色雄鹅在水边守着小鹅。

entries.meaningZh: 想象力等丰富而有创造力的
entries.en: Her fecund imagination turned an ordinary street into an entire fictional world.
entries.zh: 她丰富的想象力把一条普通街道变成了一个完整的虚构世界。

entries.meaningZh: 千瓦；等于1,000瓦的功率单位
entries.en: The display reports the machine's power consumption in kilowatts.
entries.zh: 显示屏以千瓦为单位报告机器的耗用功率。

entries.meaningZh: 友好关系；和睦，正式用语
entries.en: The neighbouring towns maintained a spirit of amity despite their sporting rivalry.
entries.zh: 尽管在体育比赛中互为对手，这两个相邻城镇仍保持着友好的关系。

entries.meaningZh: 懒散的；不愿付出努力的
entries.en: The indolent apprentice left his tools scattered while everyone else worked.
entries.zh: 大家都在工作时，那个懒散的学徒却任工具散落四处。

entries.meaningZh: 空洞乏味的；缺少生气或思想的
entries.en: Their vapid conversation revealed little about the important decision ahead.
entries.zh: 他们空洞乏味的交谈几乎没有涉及即将面临的重要决定。

entries.meaningZh: 使空气进入或通过某物；通气
entries.en: The gardener used a fork to aerate the compacted soil.
entries.zh: 园丁用园艺叉给压实的土壤通气。

entries.meaningZh: 突发的念头；任性多变的意愿
entries.en: The itinerary changed repeatedly according to the organiser's latest caprice.
entries.zh: 行程按照组织者最新的任性念头一再改变。

entries.meaningZh: 使习惯于不愉快或困难的事
entries.en: Years of outdoor work had inured her to cold mornings.
entries.zh: 多年的户外工作使她习惯了寒冷的清晨。

entries.meaningZh: 被建筑物围绕的四方庭院
entries.en: Students crossed the college quadrangle on their way to the library.
entries.zh: 学生们穿过学院的四方庭院，前往图书馆。

entries.meaningZh: 不让水等物质渗透的
entries.en: An impermeable layer kept rainwater from reaching the stored grain.
entries.zh: 一层不透水的材料防止雨水浸到储存的谷物。

entries.meaningZh: 对君主或领主的效忠，历史用语
entries.en: The knight swore fealty to the ruler before the assembled court.
entries.zh: 骑士当着全体宫廷人员的面，宣誓效忠统治者。

entries.meaningZh: 弥漫着的不快气氛或恶劣环境，比喻用法
entries.en: A miasma of suspicion surrounded the unexplained disappearance of the funds.
entries.zh: 资金去向不明，笼罩着一片猜疑的气氛。

entries.meaningZh: 历史上的契约；尤指学徒或限期劳役契约
entries.en: The archive holds the carpenter's original apprenticeship indenture.
entries.zh: 档案馆保存着那位木匠最初的学徒契约。

entries.meaningZh: 紫水晶
entries.en: A polished amethyst formed the centre of her silver pendant.
entries.zh: 她的银吊坠中央镶着一块打磨过的紫水晶。

entries.meaningZh: 像海水一样咸的；带海水气息的
entries.en: A briny breeze blew through the open windows of the seaside café.
entries.zh: 带着海水咸味的微风吹进了海边咖啡馆敞开的窗户。

entries.meaningZh: 真诚无邪的；没有心机的
entries.en: His guileless question made everyone pause before answering.
entries.zh: 他真诚无邪的问题让大家在回答前都停顿了一下。

entries.meaningZh: 因觉得受冒犯而产生的不快
entries.en: She took umbrage at the suggestion that she had not prepared.
entries.zh: 有人暗示她没有准备，她对此很不高兴。

entries.meaningZh: 表里不一的；有意欺骗的
entries.en: The duplicitous agent promised exclusive rights to two competing clients.
entries.zh: 那个两面三刀的代理人把独家权利同时许诺给了两个竞争客户。

entries.meaningZh: 举止；仪态
entries.en: Her composed deportment impressed the interview panel.
entries.zh: 她沉着的举止给面试小组留下了深刻印象。

entries.meaningZh: 象形文字的；用象形文字书写的
entries.en: The guide translated a short hieroglyphic inscription on the wall.
entries.zh: 导游翻译了墙上一段简短的象形文字铭文。

entries.meaningZh: 研究音乐历史、理论或文化的学者；音乐学家
entries.en: The musicologist traced the melody to an eighteenth-century manuscript.
entries.zh: 音乐学家把这段旋律追溯到一份十八世纪的手稿。

entries.meaningZh: 与另一词有共同来源的词；同源词
entries.en: English father and German Vater are cognates.
entries.zh: 英语 father 和德语 Vater 是同源词。

entries.meaningZh: 迅速而有效的
entries.en: An expeditious review helped the team resolve the booking error before departure.
entries.zh: 一次迅速有效的检查帮助团队在出发前解决了预订错误。

entries.meaningZh: 关切；体贴的照料
entries.en: She remembered the nurse's solicitude during her difficult first night.
entries.zh: 她记得护士在她难熬的第一晚给予的关切照料。

entries.meaningZh: 线或织物散开；脱线
entries.en: The wool began to ravel where the sleeve had torn.
entries.zh: 袖子撕破的地方，毛线开始散开。

entries.meaningZh: 摄氏温度的
entries.en: The temperature fell to five degrees centigrade before dawn.
entries.zh: 黎明前，气温降到了五摄氏度。

entries.meaningZh: 脱下帽子或衣物，较古旧用语
entries.en: He doffed his cap as the procession passed the gate.
entries.zh: 队伍经过大门时，他摘下了帽子。

entries.meaningZh: 丰富充足；充裕
entries.en: The market offered a plenitude of fresh fruit after the harvest.
entries.zh: 收获之后，市场供应着丰富的新鲜水果。

entries.meaningZh: 跨线桥；立交桥，英式用语
entries.en: The bus crossed the flyover before turning towards the hospital.
entries.zh: 公共汽车驶过跨线桥，然后转向医院。

entries.meaningZh: 对钱财或物质的贪婪
entries.en: The fable shows how avarice can destroy an otherwise comfortable life.
entries.zh: 这则寓言展示了贪财如何毁掉原本安适的生活。

entries.meaningZh: 能传送对方图像的电话；可视电话
entries.en: The museum displayed an early videophone beside other experimental communication devices.
entries.zh: 博物馆在其他实验性通信设备旁展出了一部早期可视电话。

entries.meaningZh: 概括全貌的；概要的
entries.en: The final chapter provides a synoptic view of the entire research project.
entries.zh: 最后一章概括了整个研究项目的全貌。

entries.meaningZh: 好哇；万岁，用于欢呼
entries.en: "Hurrah!" the children shouted when the repaired fountain started flowing again.
entries.zh: 修好的喷泉重新喷水时，孩子们喊道：好哇！

entries.meaningZh: 不遵从流行观念、习俗或社会规范
entries.en: Her artistic nonconformity was initially dismissed but later widely admired.
entries.zh: 她在艺术上不随俗的风格起初受到轻视，后来却广受赞赏。

entries.meaningZh: 葬礼上的哀歌或哀乐
entries.en: A slow dirge accompanied the funeral procession through the village.
entries.zh: 一首缓慢的哀乐伴着送葬队伍穿过村庄。

entries.meaningZh: 形容男性被认为举止女性化的，通常含贬义并可能冒犯
entries.en: He rejected the old assumption that gentle manners were effeminate.
entries.zh: 他反对那种认为温柔举止就带有女人气的陈旧看法。

entries.meaningZh: 混合在一起；使混合
entries.en: Voices and music commingled in the crowded courtyard.
entries.zh: 拥挤的院子里，人声与音乐混在一起。

entries.meaningZh: 认真倾听或听从，古旧用语
entries.en: The villagers were urged to hearken to the messenger's warning.
entries.zh: 村民们被敦促认真听从信使的警告。

entries.meaningZh: 猛烈撕裂；使裂开
entries.en: The storm rent the old sail from top to bottom.
entries.zh: 暴风雨把旧船帆从上到下撕裂了。

entries.meaningZh: 不高兴而爱发牢骚的
entries.en: I become grouchy when I miss breakfast and sleep badly.
entries.zh: 没吃早饭又没睡好时，我就会变得烦躁爱抱怨。

entries.meaningZh: 以某种货币单位计价或表示金额
entries.en: The invoices were denominated in euros rather than dollars.
entries.zh: 这些发票以欧元而非美元计价。

entries.meaningZh: 因失望而垂头丧气的
entries.en: She looked crestfallen when the concert was cancelled at the last minute.
entries.zh: 音乐会临时取消时，她显得垂头丧气。

entries.meaningZh: 味道辛香而开胃的
entries.en: A piquant tomato sauce added warmth to the mild vegetable dish.
entries.zh: 一份辛香开胃的番茄酱，为清淡的蔬菜菜肴增添了辣味。

entries.meaningZh: 用符号或乐谱记录
entries.en: She learned to notate the melodies she had previously played from memory.
entries.zh: 她学会了把以前凭记忆演奏的旋律记成乐谱。

entries.meaningZh: 竹荚鱼等鲹科海鱼
entries.en: The market stall displayed scad beside other freshly caught fish.
entries.zh: 集市摊位上，竹荚鱼与其他刚捕获的鱼摆在一起。

entries.meaningZh: 堵塞；遮蔽通道或视线
entries.en: A passing cloud briefly occluded the star in the telescope's view.
entries.zh: 一片飘过的云短暂遮住了望远镜视野中的那颗星。

entries.meaningZh: 潇洒而略带不羁的
entries.en: He wore his battered hat at a rakish angle.
entries.zh: 他把那顶破旧的帽子歪戴着，显得潇洒不羁。

entries.meaningZh: 积云；呈团块状的云
entries.en: White cumulus clouds gathered above the fields during the afternoon.
entries.zh: 下午，白色积云聚集在田野上空。

entries.meaningZh: 无与伦比的；出类拔萃的
entries.en: Her peerless command of rhythm made the performance unforgettable.
entries.zh: 她对节奏无与伦比的掌控让这场演出令人难忘。

entries.meaningZh: 不容忍不同意见、限制自由的
entries.en: The students challenged an illiberal rule that prohibited discussion of controversial ideas.
entries.zh: 学生们质疑了一条禁止讨论争议观点、限制思想自由的规定。

entries.meaningZh: 自以为是地发表权威意见
entries.en: He pontificated about architecture despite knowing very little about building design.
entries.zh: 他对建筑设计知之甚少，却自以为是地大谈建筑。

entries.meaningZh: 公开承认或表明
entries.en: She openly avowed her support for the unpopular proposal.
entries.zh: 她公开表明自己支持那项不受欢迎的提案。

entries.meaningZh: 好斗的态度；咄咄逼人
entries.en: His belligerence made a calm conversation about the mistake impossible.
entries.zh: 他咄咄逼人的态度，让人无法平静地讨论那个错误。

entries.meaningZh: 色彩或形态不断变化、如万花筒般的
entries.en: The dancers' costumes created a kaleidoscopic pattern as they moved.
entries.zh: 舞者们移动时，服装形成了万花筒般变幻的图案。

entries.meaningZh: 有规律的搏动或脉动
entries.en: The sensor recorded the steady pulsation of fluid through the tube.
entries.zh: 传感器记录了流体经过管道时稳定的脉动。

entries.meaningZh: 值得尊敬的
entries.en: Her quiet dedication made her an estimable member of the community.
entries.zh: 她默默奉献，成了社区里值得尊敬的一员。

entries.meaningZh: 把蒸气冷却成液体的装置；冷凝器
entries.en: Steam passed through the condenser and collected as liquid in a flask.
entries.zh: 蒸气通过冷凝器，在烧瓶中聚集成液体。

entries.meaningZh: 特别令人恼火的小事，常用于 pet peeve
entries.en: Loud phone calls on quiet trains are my pet peeve.
entries.zh: 在安静的火车上大声打电话，是特别让我恼火的事。

entries.meaningZh: 气垫船
entries.en: The hovercraft crossed the shallow water towards the sandy shore.
entries.zh: 气垫船穿过浅水，驶向沙岸。

entries.meaningZh: 躺卧或斜靠着的
entries.en: The sculpture depicts a recumbent figure resting beside a sleeping dog.
entries.zh: 这座雕塑描绘了一个斜卧着休息的人，旁边有只熟睡的狗。

entries.meaningZh: 信号或时间间隔中不规则的小幅波动；抖动
entries.en: The engineer measured jitter in the digital audio signal.
entries.zh: 工程师测量了数字音频信号中的抖动。

entries.meaningZh: 对批评或情绪刺激过度敏感的
entries.en: He was hypersensitive to criticism after the disappointing interview.
entries.zh: 那场令人失望的面试之后，他对批评格外敏感。

entries.meaningZh: 航空邮件；航空邮寄
entries.en: She sent the documents by airmail to the university overseas.
entries.zh: 她用航空邮件把文件寄往了海外的大学。

entries.meaningZh: 寻找野生食物的人或觅食的动物
entries.en: The forager searched the woodland for edible plants with an experienced guide.
entries.zh: 那位采食者跟着有经验的向导，在林地里寻找可食用植物。

entries.meaningZh: 未经鞣制的动物生皮
entries.en: The craftsperson cut strips of rawhide for the traditional drum.
entries.zh: 工匠裁下生皮条，用来制作那面传统鼓。

entries.meaningZh: 象形文字中的一个字符
entries.en: Researchers photographed each hieroglyph before cleaning the stone.
entries.zh: 研究人员在清理石头前，拍下了每个象形文字字符。

entries.meaningZh: 吝啬的；不愿花钱或给予的
entries.en: The miserly owner refused to replace even the broken office chairs.
entries.zh: 那个吝啬的老板连坏了的办公椅都不肯更换。

entries.meaningZh: 迷惑对手的假动作；佯攻
entries.en: The striker's quick feint sent the goalkeeper in the wrong direction.
entries.zh: 前锋一个迅速的假动作，让守门员扑错了方向。

entries.meaningZh: 短暂；转瞬即逝的性质
entries.en: The poem reflects on the transience of fame and youthful beauty.
entries.zh: 这首诗思考了名声与青春美貌的短暂。

entries.meaningZh: 缺乏勇气或原则的；懦弱的，贬义
entries.en: She denounced the committee's spineless refusal to defend its own decision.
entries.zh: 她谴责委员会懦弱地拒绝捍卫自己的决定。

entries.meaningZh: 勇气；闯劲，主要美式口语
entries.en: It took spunk to challenge the committee's unfair decision.
entries.zh: 挑战委员会的不公正决定需要勇气。

entries.meaningZh: 教皇的；与教皇职务有关的
entries.en: The archive preserves documents bearing the pontifical seal.
entries.zh: 档案馆保存着盖有教皇印章的文件。

entries.meaningZh: 轻率多变、缺乏责任心的
entries.en: Her flighty promises made it difficult to rely on her help.
entries.zh: 她轻率多变的承诺让人很难指望她的帮助。

entries.meaningZh: 物质凝聚成团或凝块的过程；凝结
entries.en: Students watched the coagulation of egg white during the demonstration.
entries.zh: 学生们在演示中观察了蛋清凝固的过程。

entries.meaningZh: 损害他人名誉的恶意指责或暗示，常用复数
entries.en: He refused to cast aspersions on his rival's honesty without evidence.
entries.zh: 他拒绝在没有证据的情况下中伤对手的诚实品格。
